origin.note: From walk 13's "3 of 12 documents under a search" line.

title: Search ignores case, extra spaces and word order, and matches whole words from their start
objective: Make the library search forgiving, on both libraryPage(store, userId, { q }) and GET /api/documents?q=: it ignores case and surrounding spaces, and a document matches when every search word is the start of a word in its title, in any order ("board" finds "Q3 Board Deck" but not "Onboarding Guide"). An empty or all-space search shows everything.
acceptance: "board" and "  BOARD " both find the Q3 Board Deck, and not the Onboarding Guide
"deck q3" finds it (every word, any order), "onboard" finds the Onboarding Guide, and "deck pricing" finds nothing
plan_summary: Split q and the title into words in store.listDocuments; each search word must start a title word.
